use default

let small =
    ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven",
     "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen",
     "fifteen", "sixteen", "seventeen", "eighteen", "nineteen"]

let tens =
    ["twenty", "thirty", "forty", "fifty",
     "sixty", "seventy", "eighty", "ninety"]

let scales =
    ["", "thousand", "million", "billion",
     "trillion", "quadrillion", "quintillion"]

under_hundred(value: int) -> string =>
    if value < 20 then
        small[value]
    elif value % 10 == 0 then
        tens[value / 10 - 2]
    else
        "{tens[value / 10 - 2]}-{small[value % 10]}"
    fi

under_thousand(value: int) -> string =>
    if value < 100 then
        under_hundred(value)
    elif value % 100 == 0 then
        "{small[value / 100]} hundred"
    else
        "{small[value / 100]} hundred {under_hundred(value % 100)}"
    fi

cardinal(value: long) -> string is
    if value == 0L then return "zero" fi

    let groups = LIST[string]()
    let remaining mut = value
    let scale mut = 0

    while remaining > 0L do
        let group = cast int(remaining % 1000L)

        if group > 0 then
            let name = under_thousand(group)

            groups.add(
                if scale == 0 then name else "{name} {scales[scale]}" fi)
        fi

        remaining = remaining / 1000L
        scale = scale + 1
    od

    groups |> reverse() |> join(" ")
si

let irregular =
    [(spelt = "one", ranked = "first"),
     (spelt = "two", ranked = "second"),
     (spelt = "three", ranked = "third"),
     (spelt = "five", ranked = "fifth"),
     (spelt = "eight", ranked = "eighth"),
     (spelt = "nine", ranked = "ninth"),
     (spelt = "twelve", ranked = "twelfth")]

ranked_word(word: string) -> string =>
    let special = irregular |> find(entry => entry.spelt =~ word) in
    if let known = special then
        known.ranked
    elif word[word.length - 1] == 'y' then
        "{word[0..word.length - 1]}ieth"
    else
        "{word}th"
    fi

ordinal(value: long) -> string is
    let text = cardinal(value)
    let cut =
        (0..text.length)
            |> reverse()
            |> find(index => text[index] == ' ' \/ text[index] == '-')

    if let at = cut then
        return "{text[0::at]}{ranked_word(text[at + 1..<0])}"
    fi

    ranked_word(text)
si

as_number(text: string) -> long =>
    if text.contains(".") \/ text.contains("e") \/ text.contains("E") then
        cast long(double.parse(text))
    else
        long.parse(text)
    fi
